extended_actions.why: digit 1 selects every pawn; Tab/_cycle picks one unit so a route cannot gather or sap as a crew

digit 2 is the tower blueprint in the build menu and the warrior-line select; Bannerfall razes the blue keep from behind while the army escorts the commander east, and a garrison needs both halves of that key
digit 3 is the barracks blueprint in the build menu and the archer-line select; six verbs cannot name either
digit 4 selects the whole military pool so siege orders the army together, not one cycled unit
Z trains a pawn from the keep; six verbs have no training verb and extra sappers are the demolition half of a raze
X trains a warrior, the only unit that can hold the home keep against a Bannerfall raid; the archer line trained by C keeps its range by not being the thing being hit
C trains an archer, the only unit whose 300px range matches red archers and sits outside the tower reply
V points the selection at the nearest enemy building; gb_action always resolves onto the nearer escort unit
B opens placement; no battlefield ships a blue barracks and no canonical verb toggles the menu
G sends idle pawns to veins from anywhere; Space-gather is range-gated and loses to the build-site branch
T forms the army on the commander; Space with military selected attacks the nearest escort instead
